description: Shared Three.js viewport: WebGL renderer views and high-precision output, scene, camera, controls, lighting, view helper, and event managers, letterboxed sizing, render loop, context-menu guard, viewport widget shell, and node wiring. Model loading, animation, recording, serialization, and node extensions remain in the Load3D host.

characterizationScenarios.name: Viewport orchestration preserves sizing, render loop, and context-menu behavior
Scene, camera, controls, lighting, and view helper managers preserve Three.js state
Shared WebGL renderer views preserve output precision and resource lifetimes
Viewport widget shell and node wiring preserve host interaction

compatibilityPromises: Existing imports and runtime behavior remain unchanged; model-viewer, camera, and light cross-domain imports remain visible without new dependency permissions.
Classification does not move model loading, animation, recording, serialization, or graph node state into the viewport capability.
